name: AirIndex India - n8n Cloud Demo (No Env Required)

parameters.jsCode:
return [{json:{
  workflow_version:"0.4.0-cloud-demo",
  source_url:"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nikhil-247/airindex-india/feature/phase-3-index-engine/data/demo/replay_source.json",
  ingest_enabled:false,
  ingest_url:"https://YOUR-PROJECT.vercel.app/api/v1/ingest/fare-observations",
  index_enabled:false,
  index_url:"https://YOUR-PROJECT.vercel.app/api/v1/demo/index",
  anomaly_threshold_pct:35,
  freshness_limit_minutes:180,
  minimum_observations:3,
  minimum_routes:3,
  batch_size:50,
  run_id:"cloud-demo-"+new Date().toISOString().replace(/[-:.TZ]/g,""),
  started_at:new Date().toISOString()
}}];

const d=$input.first()?.json??{}; const q=$('Anomaly + Quality Scoring').first().json; const batches=$('Controlled Batch Planner').all();
return [{json:{run_id:q.run_id,status:"n8n_quality_complete",workflow_version:q.workflow_version,source_count:q.source_count,accepted_count:q.observations.length,rejected_count:q.rejected_count,duplicate_or_rejected_examples:q.rejected_examples,distinct_routes:q.distinct_routes,anomaly_count:q.anomaly_count,anomaly_rate_pct:q.anomaly_rate_pct,quality_avg:q.quality_avg,batch_count:batches.length,ingest_enabled:$('Demo Configuration').first().json.ingest_enabled,api_response:d}}];

const audit=$('Build Intelligence Audit').first().json; const p=$input.first()?.json??{};
return [{json:{...audit,latest_index:p.national_index??p.index??null,index_status:p.status??"demo-only",provenance:{source_url:$('Demo Configuration').first().json.source_url,generated_at:new Date().toISOString()}}}];

const d=$input.first().json; return [{json:{...d,finished_at:new Date().toISOString(),message:"AirIndex Cloud Demo pipeline completed",presentation_note:"Turn ingest_enabled on after Vercel deployment; keep replay values labelled as demo data."}}];
